prerequisites.runtime: Node.js with npx is required for context7; the server is launched as `npx @upstash/context7-mcp` on this machine rather than installed.
prerequisites.network: Outbound HTTPS to learn.microsoft.com (microsoft-learn), registry.npmjs.org (the context7 package download) and the Context7 service endpoint.
prerequisites.data: Neither server reads this repository. Both answer documentation questions from public sources, and neither is given file-system access, credentials or a connection string.
prerequisites.note: Both servers are declared together or not at all: a declaration whose runtime is missing costs a failed launch on every session.
